prototipos.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the supplied screenshot of Tuki's current main menu (ref 1) as one finished 16:9 full-screen game title menu. The second screenshot shows the actual simple WebGL game materials to preserve; use its pips, honey birch, matte deep teal paint and flat cream shadows. Compose one beautiful playable-looking scene, no web page elements. Mood of a quiet Argentinian indie tabletop puzzle. Frame a close, low-oblique view of a tabletop stretching edge to edge, illuminated by soft light from upper left. On the right two thirds a dramatic but simple curved chain of seven squat upright teal wooden dominoes, a few leaning in succession, with creamy pips, natural wooden edges and contact shadows. Hint of a closed teal book at far right back if needed. Left third naturally quiet pale birch for the interface, no panels. Near left-center place the specific official 'Tuki' signature from screenshot 1 with its two little leaning teal and orange tiles to its left, reproduce its lowercase letterforms and black-green color, slightly larger than menu text. Below logo align ONE medium compact warm orange button marked '▶ Jugar'. Two compact secondary unboxed dark-ink controls on separate lines 'Desafíos' and 'Taller libre'; latter in subdued ink with tiny padlock (this is first launch). Small separate sound and sliders icons at upper right on opaque cream discs. No other words or numbers. Title screen at rest, not an illustration for a poster. No border or decorative doodles, no photographic blur over foreground dominoes. Keep pieces identical and realistically spaced for a falling chain. Crisp legible dark typography and spacious single screen. Text verbatim only: “Tuki”, “Jugar”, “Desafíos”, “Taller libre”. No watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup. Transform screenshot 1 (Tuki site-like menu) into its own dedicated full-viewport level selection screen, artistically restrained high-fidelity 16:9 indie 3D game screenshot, no web-page cards. Screenshot 2 is material/geometry reference: simple low-poly rounded-edge teal domino face, cream inlaid pips, bare birch sides, warm simple WebGL shadows. Set on a wooden tabletop filling the full screen with soft light. A small opaque warm-ivory back-arrow button and heading 'Desafíos' sit at top left. Main attraction is a single centered 3D preview of LA CURVA: small matte sand-colored straight-sided tumbler WITHOUT A HANDLE in the middle with two teal dominoes standing to either side, unbuilt puzzle, nothing else on the preview. At the low middle sit a small cream label '02 · La curva' and one orange 'Jugar' button. At the bottom, level selection uses a single tactile wooden domino rack a little like a scrabble rack, holding exactly EIGHT side-by-side compact ivory square selectors in this order '01' '02' '03' '04' '05' '06' '07' '08'. 01 has a check, 02 selected with a thick teal outline, 03 to 08 each carry a tiny discreet lock and are muted yet clearly legible. Elegant balanced single scene. User has completed first level and is browsing second. Short dark typography Bricolage/DM Sans. No hero, no toolbar, no captions/slideshow arrows, no duplicate titles other than necessary, no slogans, no paragraphs, no status text or inventory. All text verbatim as requested; one single full-bleed screen, no device frame or mockup labels. Game art achievable in Three.js, striking but simple.

Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the UI overlay of this exact screenshot of Tuki's playable first level La recta. One crisp finished wide 16:9 game frame. Preserve the existing game's simple real-time orthographic 3D scene and the scale, silhouette, materials, geometry and diagonal alignment of the two original standing fixed dominoes, the left start arrow medallion, the right orange flag medallion, and the completely empty gap between them. Preserve wooden table, matte petroleum painted dominoes, pale pips, honey wood edges, untextured cream world, simple shadows. Extend the view of this same basic board across the frame. This is an interface design paintover, do not upgrade lighting to a photograph, do not add props or dominoes. Remove both full-width bars. Instead top left a compact opaque ivory plaque, small back-chevron, and one line '01 · La recta'. Top right a compact ivory double camera-control showing top view and recenter icons plus a small settings/sliders control where sound and contextual help live. At bottom LEFT, float one compact rounded matte ivory tool tray with a small actual illustrated single teal tile with counter '× 6', hairline separator and an elegant stroke icon with the text 'Trazar fila'. No other active editing controls in this initial state. At bottom RIGHT an orange action '▶ Empujar' in a compact button with dark ink, same footprint as the tool tray height. Let wood show behind and BETWEEN the controls; no background bar over the whole bottom or top. Safe inset around controls, crisp text on opaque surfaces, medium corner radii, Bricolage/DM Sans typeface, focus on the two tiles and the playable space. Avoid big text, copy, labels or headings beyond the four strings supplied, no watermark, no promo visuals.

Use case: ui-mockup. One alternative portrait title screen for the existing Spanish indie domino game Tuki. The main visual reference is screenshot 1, the REAL game: match its austere low-poly WebGL appearance, matte birch tabletop with sparse simple grain, oil-teal wooden-faced dominoes with pale pips and raw wood sides, modest flat lighting and hard-edged contact shadows. Screenshot 2 is the old mobile start screen; reuse ONLY its authentic exact logo/signature consisting of two small leaning tiles to the left of the word Tuki (capital T, lowercase uki). Discard old web content and web header. Design a finished full-bleed VERTICAL smartphone screen, aspect 9:19.5, no phone frame, no status/navigation chrome. Alternative title approach: the first actual puzzle forms the entire background. Single ivory surface meeting tabletop, a warm birch board fills the middle 62% of frame, with exactly two visually clear standing deep teal dominoes, at opposite ends of a visible empty gap, board rotated so the path runs diagonally between upper left and lower right on the phone. Each is prominent. Small teal arrow medallion indicating direction on the left tile and burnt orange finish-flag medallion on the right. No other objects, no extra tiles, no overly realistic photography or bokeh. TOP LEFT the compact authentic Tuki signature sits on ivory safe space; TOP RIGHT a single small cream settings icon comfortably inset. The menu is anchored at the bottom over naturally pale ivory in a tactile game style. Short small dark text '01 · La recta' above one compact, centered, solid mandarin-orange button '▶ Jugar' with sturdy dark lettering, and below it one secondary unboxed row with 'Desafíos' and a tiny lock beside 'Taller libre'. Good alignment, dark ink, generous negative space, all buttons within generous horizontal thumb-safe margins; a single screen, no scrolling. Do not write any other text, no paragraphs or slogans or marketing, no borders or decorative separators or launcher-style content panels. Everything distinguishable at 390 pixels wide. Ordinary legible Bricolage/DM Sans typography. The image should feel like an achievable in-engine menu and visibly show the puzzle before play.
